CommonCause.description:
Two or more components on one shared drive chain are abnormal at the same time (S19, D-038).

The drive chain is the likelier single cause than separate wear of each component, so it is
pointed out next to each component's own health output. Health states themselves are unchanged.

DataQualityReport.description:
Quality of one signal over a window, computed on full-resolution rows (L4-01, L2-06).

Problems are reported, never corrected: values stay as delivered. Checks that cannot be evaluated
for this signal or source are listed in ``not_evaluated`` instead of being reported as clean.

DegradationHistory.description:
Long-term history of one feature for a component (L4-05), across maintenance and lifecycles.

Maintenance keeps a lifecycle and its history continuous; a replacement starts a new segment whose
deviations are measured only against that lifecycle's own verified reference.

Evidence.description:
Unified evidence object (D-043). Every rule, statistic and model reports in this shape; the
decision never adds raw scores of different algorithms. ``applicable``, ``reason``, ``model_version``,
``evaluated_at`` and ``input_window_id`` are derived from the stored fields so they cannot disagree.

standstill bias) and gap spacing. Speed/torque pairs default to signals of the same component.
